text: Where the work includes refrigeration or air conditioning equipment, the tenderer must hold a valid F-gas qualification (F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen patevyys).
The tenderer must hold a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate at the time the tender is submitted.
Response time for emergency situations and the associated on-call arrangement.
Environmental management arrangements during the course of the work.
Handover of the asset register and associated documentation.
Cost breakdown requirement for the quoted price.
CVs of the key personnel proposed for the contract.
Prices shall be set out in EUR/m2/year rather than EUR/month.
The quotation must be submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection.
The minimum font size used throughout the quotation document shall be 11 pt.
Tenders must be submitted by e-mail to hankinta@myllyrantaelintarvike.example no later than 20 March 2026, 12:00 (Helsinki time).
Reporting practice to the client during the contract.
Compliance of lift maintenance with applicable statutory requirements.
Description of the tenderer's environmental management system.
